Hi Jill / Carlos —

Congrats again on signing. Attached is our first draft of the post-signature action sequence (named StrataMed_MAP_v1.xlsx) and an implementation checklist. This is intended to sit inside the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and act as the single place we track go/no-go gates, owners, and dates through cutover.

High level proposal (please confirm):
- Kickoff workshop (remote): target week of Sep 1 — 2. Proposed date: Wed, Sep 1, 10:00–12:00 PT.
- Canary window: two-week canary, Sep 6–20, limited to a single region (US-West) and 10% traffic.
- Migration approach: rolling per-region cutover (US-West -> US-East -> EU) with fallback flagging.
- Training: two cohorts (Admin + Ops) the week before go-live; train-the-trainer session during kickoff.
- Acceptance criteria: SLA smoke tests (latency under 200ms p50), model-output regression checks on our eval suite, and remediation runbook validated in staging.

Key owners (draft):
- Redwood PM / delivery: Marissa Cole
- Redwood infra / canary ops: Vivek Kulkarni
- StrataMed technical lead: Jill Park
- StrataMed product/ops: Carlos Mendez

Open asks for you today:
1) Confirm kickoff date (Sep 1) or propose alternatives.
2) Confirm whether StrataMed prefers a rolling migration (recommended) or a single cutover.
3) Share SOC2 evidence or point us to where procurement can pull it (we need to attach to procurement packet).

I've also added a short checklist in the spreadsheet for the first 30 days (network allowlist, test data sample, API staging creds). If you agree, we'll convert this into a living MAP in the shared Drive link and hand off a scoped SOW to your procurement team.

Attachments: StrataMed_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), implementation_checklist.pdf (checklist & milestones)

Thanks — looking forward to your read.

—

Thanks, Jill — noted. Two operational clarifications from my side: 

1) Canary cadence and rollback criteria
Proposed plan:
- Canary week 0: Sep 6–13 — 10% synthetic + internal test traffic.
- Canary week 1: Sep 13–20 — increase to 30% if no high-severity regressions.
Rollback triggers (examples): repeated SLA misses for 3 consecutive hours, model quality regression on the evaluation set > 5% error rate, or critical production errors >= 3 in an hour.

2) Staging API keys
We will provision staging API keys for StrataMed. Marissa, I'll need the StrataMed staging service account email to add to our staging org by Sep 2 so keys can be issued by EOD Sep 3. Please only use staging for test data — don't run production traffic.

3) Migration style
Rolling per-region cutover is our recommended approach. We will prepare a step in the MAP to gate each region behind an acceptance checklist (smoke tests + eval pass).

I'll add a short operations checklist to the Drive folder and map owners to each canary gate.

—
